content.title: Product-Centered Material Orbit | Liquid Ring, Particle Crest, Hero Reset
content.summary: A perfume vial drives an oil-ring-to-glass-plinth proof chain. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One registered product geometry anchors every state. + Material begins from one visible product-adjacent trigger. + Each state adds one material behavior only. + Effects never obscure the product identity. + The clean lockup restores the complete product and one exact line.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one fictional copper perfume vial upright on a charcoal stage with its complete silhouette visible. Thicken the ring into two transparent glassy folds while the vial label stays unobscured. Settle every particle into a clear circular plinth and hold the untouched vial beside the exact line AURA / 01.
required_anchors: One registered product geometry anchors every state.
Material begins from one visible product-adjacent trigger.
Effects never obscure the product identity.
The clean lockup restores the complete product and one exact line.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A perfume vial drives an oil-ring-to-glass-plinth proof chain. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.
